title: Add wifi to your Bigtreetech mainboard/touchscreen - ESP-01S guide
description: I've had plenty of requests to make a guide on adding a Bigtreetech ESP-01S WIFI module to SKR boards and TFT touch screens, so here it is. While nowhere near as good as Octoprint, it is very cheap and could be useful. The situation is sure to improve thanks to the developer behind the firmware and web interface.  These steps may be compatible with other ESP8266 hardware but there is no guarantee.  This BTT writer and BTT ESP-01S were sent to me free of charge with an SKR V1.4 Turbo board for the purposes of making this guide. All opinions expressed are my own.
